parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description: The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or feature configurations. This parameter takes effect only when functionName is specified.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: RouteName
parameters.description: The route name. You can use this parameter to query the rule whose name matches the specified value. This parameter takes effect only when functionName is specified.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
